attributes.name: Classification & grouping
attributes.role: Group products into classes or categories.
attributes.aps: Drives changeover families, campaign grouping, and reporting dimensions.

attributes.name: Descriptive attributes
attributes.role: Defined traits carried as values on the master record.
attributes.aps: Feed sequencing rules, compatibility, and constraint logic.

attributes.name: Planning master fields
attributes.role: Lot size, safety stock, lead time, scrap, strategy.
attributes.aps: Set lot-sizing, buffers, and horizons directly in the schedule.

attributes.name: Variant / configuration
attributes.role: Configurable options that resolve a concrete product.
attributes.aps: Late differentiation and configured BOM / routing selection.

attributes.name: Batch / serial attributes
attributes.role: Values specific to a lot, batch, or serial instance.
attributes.aps: Potency, expiry, and grade constrain which supply is usable.

attributes.name: Quality / process parameters
attributes.role: Inspection characteristics, CPP, CQA, and spec limits.
attributes.aps: Release gates and process windows that bound feasibility.
